metrics.not_a_strength_claim: 62 compatibility fallbacks in the block invalidate any win-rate reading; single seed

result: Engine runs fixed-vs-fixed 4-player games end to end with zero crashes and zero illegal actions. Reproducible bit-for-bit across two independent process launches when PYTHONHASHSEED=0 is pinned; NOT reproducible otherwise (see the critical PYTHONHASHSEED finding in docs/REFERENCE_AUDIT.md, discovered via this same experiment run without the pin first). 62 compatibility fallbacks in the block mean this is an engine-plumbing smoke, not a strength baseline (see docs/BASELINE.md's reclassification).
